review.posthog_relevance: Adds Humanitec as a supported warehouse ingestion source, allowing PostHog users to connect and ingest warehouse metadata and application data.
review.reason: The implementation adds a new warehouse connector for Humanitec. P1.F1.H1 registers the connector in the supported sources inventory. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F3.H1 establish the configuration contract and metadata definitions. P1.F6.H2 adds the warehouse source to the configuration options. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: enabling a new ingestion path. No P1.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a new connector, which is a substantive capability. However, the actual benefit depends on the existence and compatibility of the Humanitec warehouse API and the willingness of users to adopt this specific connector, neither of which is demonstrated by the code alone. No tier assignment is requested.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete implementation of a new warehouse connector. No other PRs are present, so no unrelated-PR uncertainty exists. No tier assignment is requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a new row for humanitec to the supported sources list, while removing it from a compatibility list.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds humanitec to the supported warehouse sources inventory; P1.F1.H2 removes it from a compatibility list, indicating this is a new supported connector rather than a compatibility fix.

observations.behavior: Defines the configuration class and its required fields for the Humanitec connector.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes the configuration contract for the Humanitec warehouse connector, requiring an API token and organization ID.

observations.behavior: Defines the canonical descriptions and column metadata for Humanitec warehouse entities.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides metadata and documentation for warehouse entities, including descriptions and column names, used by PostHog's warehouse metadata and visualization.
